rationale: This is an explicit counterpattern: affection is broad and high-amplitude from the outset, without a restrained baseline or selective softening. Keep it diagnostic and out of positive discovery tagging.

anchors.quote: Warmth is openly and broadly displayed from the start, so there is no stable low-expression baseline or selective small softening.
